blocks.text: VATICAN CITY — Pope Leo XIV will miss a planned trip to Assisi next week on doctors’ orders as he continues recovering from thoracic surgery he underwent last Tuesday, the Vatican said Friday. The pope had been due to attend an Oct. 27 gathering marking the 40th anniversary of St. John Paul II’s World Day of Prayer for Peace. In a statement, the Vatican said Leo was advised not to travel “to facilitate his recovery” from the surgery.
